RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything. Panels skew one way or the other constantly; in a newsroom with many senior women it's unremarkable. Raising it would be your weakest argument and would likely be read as attributing your loss to your sex rather than to the panel's reasoning — which damages your standing internally and in any formal process.

Your real grievance is procedural: you asked for written reasons two weeks ago and got silence. Chase that, in writing, to HR with a deadline.

Note also that "strong digital experience" against your fifteen traditional-news years is a genuinely plausible differentiator, not a pretext. If the written reasons turn out inconsistent or shifting, reassess then — on that evidence, not on headcount.
